author: Myv
body:
ORIGINAL POST: https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/0e988e4f2

Hello, I am back with the new and improved version of my map Vicus. Due to feedback for the previous version, it has come to my attention that this could possibly work as a tournament map for the future so I have added TE to its title, though this is only provisional.

Map Information

Team Colours: Maroon and Turquoise
Team Sizes: Well, if it were to be a TE map, a limit of about 10v10, if public, 16v16.
Time Limit: According to cores changing etc.
Loadout: Again would depend on its use, but Stone Sword, Infinity Bow, 4 Gapples, 64 glass, stone bricks and quartz, 64 steak, full leather coloured armour, diamond pickaxe.

XML and DOWNLOAD will be done if needed.

Album: http://imgur.com/a/sAOyB

Please note that the mid was intended to be basic to encourage bridging and more strategic forms of crossing, important in tournaments.

Also, the chest in the middle contains a Punch I, Power I bow.

Please feel free to leave feedback below so I can improve if necessary, thank you

Myv
